Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian RFP: Security clarifications & evidence request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick onboarding earlier this week. Attached is Meridian's security questionnaire (tabbed for SOC 2 / ISO / SIG). Our procurement/security team has a few clarifications and a short list of requested artifacts to validate controls. Could you please confirm you can provide the following by EOD next Tuesday (Oct 5)?

- Current SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- SSP or equivalent system description
- Network diagram (we understand some redaction is fine)
- SSO/SAML metadata and vendor compliance attestations

I've attached the worksheet (meridian-rfp-questions.xlsx) with inline questions. If you prefer, a secure file handoff link + short walkthrough call is fine.

Appreciate it — happy to loop in folks on our side for any clarifications.

Best,
Sara Liu
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Meridian Health

Sara —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear spreadsheet. We can provide the items you listed. Proposed plan:

1) We will share the SOC 2 Type II report (2026) and our SSP (redwood-ssp-2027-v1.pdf) via a secure transfer by EOD Oct 4.
2) Network diagram will be provided with IP redaction; Neha will coordinate the redaction.
3) For SSO/SAML metadata we'll include metadata.xml and a short note on our IdP posture.

If that timeline works, I'll package the artifacts and upload them to a secure folder and send a transfer link. Would you like a short 30-minute call to review any of the controls after you ingest the artifacts?

Cc'ing Neha and Marissa to own artifact delivery and control mapping questions.

Team —

Thread: Meridian Health RFP (MH-2027-114). External asked for SOC2, SSP, network diagram, and SSO metadata. Need to hand off by EOD Oct 4 (apologies for tight turnaround). Please confirm ownership and ETA below:

- SOC2 Type II (redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf) — Marissa: confirm redaction policy and final file (ETA: 10/04 12:00).
- SSP (ssp-redwood-2027-v1.pdf) — Neha: update control owner list and include control mappings (ETA: 10/04 15:00).
- Network diagram (redaction required) — Connor: prepare diagram, mask any outbound IP addresses, annotate firewall zones (ETA: 10/04 14:00).
- Transfer + access controls — Kim: I'll create the secure Box folder and send link once files are ready.

Please reply inline with any blockers. If legal redlines are likely for any artifact, flag and I'll loop in Legal.

Thanks — short, focused timeline on this one.

-Kim

Kim / team —

Status update:

- SOC2: I have the 2026 report from Audit. Marissa, please confirm whether we should redact any control IDs or include the full AICPA cover letter.
- SSP: I'm adding the latest control owner table and mapping columns for SOC2/ISO/SIG. Will push the draft at ~15:00.
- Network diagram: Connor will produce a redacted PNG. A quick FYI from Legal: they prefer that we remove traceroute-able IPs and any third-party vendor private endpoints.

Question: Meridian asked for SSO/SAML metadata — we can provide the metadata and a short description of our IdP (Okta) configuration. Do we include sample SAML assertions? Legal suggests not.

I'll draft an explanation paragraph for any redactions so Meridian understands what was masked.

-Neha
